result.summary: Found 2 issues: unreadable low-contrast promo banner text and inconsistent favorite-icon styling.

issues.description: Promotional banner '3 free deliveries for you' and subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout...' use white text on a very light mint-green background, making the text almost unreadable due to insufficient contrast.
issues.suggestion: Change banner text to a dark color or darken the banner background to meet WCAG contrast requirements for readability

issues.description: Favorite heart icon styling is inconsistent in 'Popular right now': the icon on Tokumaru Ramen Bar has no circular background while the icon on the pizza card below has a dark translucent circular background.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent favorite-button style with a translucent background behind the heart icon on all cards for visibility and consistency
